title: Akvan delays two Howrah-bound trains from Hyderabad today

slides.head: Akvan delays two Howrah-bound trains from Hyderabad today
What happened
slides.body: SCR rescheduled the Charlapalli–Shalimar East Coast Express and Secunderabad–Howrah Falaknuma Express for Nov 19.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: Cyclone Akvan is affecting the east coast route these trains take towards Howrah.

slides.head: Did you know
slides.body: The Charlapalli–Shalimar East Coast Express now leaves 7 hours after its usual 8.40 am slot.

captions.instagram:
Akvan delays two Howrah-bound trains from Hyderabad today

South Central Railway rescheduled two express trains on Thursday because of Cyclone Akvan. The East Coast Express (18046) leaves Charlapalli at 3.40 pm and the Falaknuma Express (12704) leaves Secunderabad at 5.55 pm.

Why it matters: Cyclone Akvan is affecting the east coast route these trains take towards Howrah.

Source: Telangana Today. Image: Telangana Today
